item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q014_paper_example_reclassification_pa1492","answer":"In SCOP 1.69, PA1492 from PDB 1t1j was not classified with nucleoside 2-deoxyribosyltransferase from PDB 1f8y beyond the broad all-alpha-and-beta class: 1t1j chains A/B were domains d1t1ja_ and d1t1jb_ in the PA1492-only fold/superfamily/family c.137/c.137.1/c.137.1.1, while 1f8y chains A/B were d1f8ya_ and d1f8yb_ in the Flavodoxin-like fold c.23, N-deoxyribosyltransferase superfamily c.23.14, and N-deoxyribosyltransferase family c.23.14.1. In the current public SCOPe release 2.08, the folded PA1492 domain has been moved into the Flavodoxin-like fold and into the same N-(deoxy)ribosyltransferase-like superfamily as 1f8y: d1t1ja1/d1t1jb1 are c.23.14.2, the separate Hypothetical protein PA1492 family, whereas d1f8ya_/d1f8yb_ remain the N-deoxyribosyltransferase family c.23.14.1. Thus the SCOPe relationship changed from \"same class only, no inferred close relationship\" in 1.69 to \"same superfamily, probable common ancestry\" in 2.08, but not to the same family or protein. The appropriate comparison is against the 1t1j residues 1-118 domains; the extra current SCOPe l.1.1.1 entries on residues around 0 are not the PA1492 structural domain. The reclassification supports remote homology and use of an N-(deoxy)ribosyltransferase-like/flavodoxin-like template at the fold or superfamily level; it does not by itself justify copying nucleoside 2-deoxyribosyltransferase enzymatic function to PA1492 as if it were a member of the c.23.14.1 family.","evidence_used":["mcp__scope.get_scop_service_info: /api/v1/, /api/v1/releases/current","mcp__scope.get_scop_pdb_entry: /api/v1/releases/1.69/pdb/1t1j, /api/v1/releases/1.69/pdb/1t1j/domains, /api/v1/releases/1.69/pdb/1t1j/chains, /api/v1/releases/1.69/pdb/1f8y, /api/v1/releases/1.69/pdb/1f8y/domains, /api/v1/releases/1.69/pdb/1f8y/chains, /api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1t1j, /api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1t1j/domains, /api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1t1j/chains, /api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1f8y, /api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1f8y/domains, /api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1f8y/chains","mcp__scope.compare_scop_domains: /api/v1/releases/1.69/sids/d1t1ja_, /api/v1/releases/1.69/sids/d1t1ja_/parents, /api/v1/releases/1.69/sids/d1t1ja_/annotations, /api/v1/releases/1.69/sids/d1t1ja_/homology, /api/v1/releases/1.69/sids/d1f8ya_, /api/v1/releases/1.69/sids/d1f8ya_/parents, /api/v1/releases/1.69/sids/d1f8ya_/annotations, /api/v1/releases/1.69/sids/d1f8ya_/homology, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1t1ja1, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1t1ja1/parents, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1t1ja1/annotations, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1t1ja1/homology, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1f8ya_, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1f8ya_/parents, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1f8ya_/annotations, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1f8ya_/homology"]}]}
